## guardian lane F' — adversarial audit finding (2026-10-02)

**BUG (pin-coverage):** two classes of algorithm substitution passed **all six pins silently**, contradicting P6's stated purpose ("algorithm substitution cannot pass silently").

### Escapes demonstrated (mutation → result before this PR)
| mutation in `lab/chain.py` | P1–P5 | P6 |
|---|---|---|
| separator `\|` → `\|\|` in append()+verify() | PASS | **PASS — silent** |
| wire format `%016x` → `%016X` (uppercase receipts) | PASS | **PASS — silent** |

Both produce a **byte-incompatible chain** (cross-implementation P5 anchors break), yet every pin stayed green, because P6 exercises only the raw `fnv1a64()` compression function on byte strings — never the receipt *construction* (`prev_receipt + "|" + op`, lowercase zero-padded hex, genesis basis encoding) that the README doctrine defines as part of the algorithm. Additionally, `ReceiptChain.verify()` was called by **zero** pins (P3 recomputes via `append()`), so a verify()-breaking mutation also escaped.

For contrast, genuine arithmetic mutations were correctly caught by P6 (and P6 only): prime 435→436, offset-basis ±1, xor/multiply order swap, mask 64→48.

### Fix: P6b construction-canonical
Known-answer vectors over the **full** construction, plus a `verify()` exercise:

```python
rc = ReceiptChain()
v2 = rc.head == "cbf29ce484222325" and     rc.append("alpha") == "93fad21a78b7d2cf" and     rc.append("beta-0000002a") == "c1fffbe12137ec9b" and     rc.verify()
pin("P6b construction-canonical", v2, ...)
```

### Red/green evidence
- Clean tree: P1–P6b all PASS (exit 0)
- separator mutation → `FAIL P6b` (previously silent)
- hex-case mutation → `FAIL P6b` (previously silent)
- prime mutation → `FAIL P6` + `FAIL P6b`

README pin table updated (also backfills the P6 row missing since PR #2).

Full audit writeup: `/tmp/guardian-f.md` on the guardian host; remaining findings (genesis-anchor unattestation, un-receipted forensic channel, n=0 vacuity) are documented honest LIMITs, not bugs.

Note: filed as a same-repo branch PR because the authenticated account owns the repo (GitHub refuses self-forks); `guardian` is the audit branch.
title: guardian lane F': P6b construction-canonical — close silent algorithm-substitution escapes

body: Audit finding (2026-10-02): a self-consistent sig cannot detect algorithm substitution — write and verify share the implementation (corrupting the prime passed every other pin). Red-demonstrated: corrupted prime → P6 FAIL, all other pins green. Green on canonical fnv1a-64 vectors. Same fix filed for quilt-in-git w3a as a stacked PR.
title: pins: P6 sig-canonical — algorithm pinned to reference vectors
